descriptionIntro: How powerful is Doctor Doom on a normal day? This is the first Power Profile in The Power Index: Marvel's own power grid for Doom, our sorcery rating, and what changes when he has a plan or borrows cosmic power. Fantastic Four #5, Books of Doom, Triumph and Torment, the Silver Surfer heist in Fantastic Four #57 to #60, both Secret Wars, and five books to start with.
